description: Prices a list of building/renovation items (by code from list_cost_items, with quantities) for a South African region and quality level. Returns material and labour per line, preliminaries, contingency, VAT, total and a likely range in rand.

contingency_pct.description: Allowance for unforeseen costs, as % of the works. Default 10

include_vat.description: Add 15% VAT to the total. Default true

items.description: Items to price, each an item code and a quantity

code.description: Item code from list_cost_items, e.g. ROOF-IBR

quantity.description: Quantity in the item's unit (m², m, each, etc.)

preliminaries_pct.description: Site setup, supervision, rubble etc. Default 8

quality.description: Finish quality: economy, standard or premium. Default standard

region.description: Region id: cape-town, cape-winelands, west-coast, overberg, garden-route, johannesburg, pretoria, durban, gqeberha, bloemfontein or rural. Default cape-town

name: estimate_works
title: Estimate cost of building or renovation work
